description: Mode-by-mode boundary behaviour at a tie, in both signs, for the closed enum of ADR-0002 §2.4. Basis does not change the arithmetic — it names the point at which content applies the policy — so the sets exercise all four values without expecting them to move a digit.

provenance.oracle: General Decimal Arithmetic Specification — quantize, and the rounding modes table
provenance.contentVersion: n/a — engine vectors, authored against the specification rather than against a content bundle

cases.oracle: Specification, round-half-up: a discarded 5 rounds away from zero. This is the mode most VAT and sales-tax instruments mandate at the line.
Specification, round-half-even: the retained digit 4 is already even, so the tie resolves downward.
Specification, round-half-even: the retained digit 5 is odd, so the same tie resolves upward. The pair with half-even-positive-tie-keeps-even is the whole difference between HALF_EVEN and HALF_UP.
Specification, round-half-down: a discarded 5 rounds toward zero.
Specification, round-down: truncation toward zero, ties irrelevant.
Specification, round-up: away from zero whenever any discarded digit is non-zero.
Specification, round-ceiling: toward positive infinity. Indistinguishable from UP on a positive value, which is why the negative pair below is the case that matters.
Specification, round-floor: toward negative infinity.

Specification, round-half-up: away from zero, symmetrically. This vector pins the symmetric reading of HALF_UP on credits and refunds; ADR-0002 §7.2 is open on whether any authority mandates the asymmetric form, and if one does it arrives as a new mode, not as a change here.
Specification, round-half-even: sign-symmetric; the retained digit 4 is even.
Specification, round-half-down: toward zero, sign-symmetric.
Specification, round-down: toward zero, so a negative value rounds up in magnitude terms and never past it.
Specification, round-up: away from zero.
Specification, round-ceiling: toward positive infinity, which on a negative value means toward zero. The pair with up-negative is what separates CEILING from UP.
Specification, round-floor: toward negative infinity, which on a negative value means away from zero.

Elementary arithmetic. The case exists because 1.005 is not representable in binary floating-point — it is 1.00499999999999989... — so a float64 implementation returns 1.00 here while believing it rounded half-up.

Specification, round-half-even. 0.125 is exactly representable in binary too, so this case agrees under float64 — included so that the corpus is not composed solely of cases chosen to embarrass floats.
Specification, round-half-even at scale 0.

Specification, round-half-even at scale 0. With the previous case, the pair shows the statistical symmetry that makes HALF_EVEN the right default statistically and the wrong one legally (ADR-0002 §4.1).
ISO 4217 gives JPY an exponent of 0, so a JPY line rounds at scale 0. Scale 0 is a legal scale and is why a decoded policy must distinguish an absent scale from a scale of zero (ADR-0002 §2.3).
ISO 4217 gives KWD and BHD an exponent of 3. ADR-0002 §7.1 keeps the exponent table itself on the CONTENT train; the engine only has to honour the scale it is given.

Rounding an already-rounded value at the same scale changes nothing. Asserted here as a vector and over generated inputs as a property test, because a materialisation step that is not idempotent makes the number of times a value passes through the boundary fiscally significant.
Specification, quantize: quantizing to a finer exponent than the operand's pads with zeros and never loses a digit. A tax component carried at scale 4 states its scale.

Specification: the sign of a zero result is the sign of the operand. A negative zero is a real value in this arithmetic and reaches evidence as "-0.00", so the corpus states what both engines must render rather than leaving the first occurrence to a production credit note.
